identity.description: After reaching the ESXi management plane, an adversary issues shell commands rarely seen on virtualization hosts — spawning an interactive shell, adding a backdoor local account, disabling syslog forwarding to blind the SOC, and powering off / encrypting VMs for ransomware impact. ESXi forwards its shell/hostd command log to a Cortex Broker VM over syslog; the Cortex Analytics per-host rarity model raises 'Uncommon command executed on a virtualization host'. CortexSim reproduces the detectable syslog telemetry with esxi_syslog_emitter.py — no real ESXi is touched.

techniques.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

payload.code:
# CortexSim ESXi uncommon-command analytics validation — streams shape-true
# ESXi shell syslog records to the lab Broker VM. No real ESXi is touched; the
# attacker commands appear ONLY as syslog TEXT the Cortex analytics model reads.
COLLECTOR="${BROKER_VM:-192.0.2.9}"
# 1) establish the learned-normal baseline the per-host rarity model trains on
python3 core/eal_simulator/esxi_syslog_emitter.py --collector "$COLLECTOR" --phase baseline --baseline-count 40
# 2) emit the uncommon hypervisor-CLI commands that should raise the analytics alert
python3 core/eal_simulator/esxi_syslog_emitter.py --collector "$COLLECTOR" --phase attack

expected_artifacts.description: ESXi shell syslog record for a backdoor local-account add on the hypervisor.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: dataset esxi_syslog: command contains 'esxcli system account add'

expected_artifacts.description: ESXi shell syslog record disabling syslog forwarding (audit tampering).
expected_artifacts.expected_value: dataset esxi_syslog: command contains 'esxcli system syslog config set --loghost'

expected_artifacts.description: ESXi shell syslog record powering off / encrypting all VMs (ransomware impact).
expected_artifacts.expected_value: dataset esxi_syslog: command contains 'vim-cmd vmsvc/power.off' or '.vmdk'

xql_queries.name: ESXi Uncommon Hypervisor-CLI Command on the Syslog Feed
xql_queries.query:
dataset = esxi_syslog
| filter command ~= "esxcli system account add|esxcli system permission set|system syslog config set|system coredump|vim-cmd vmsvc/power.off|\.vmdk|pty.spawn"
| comp count() as hits by agent_hostname, user, command
| sort desc hits

xql_queries.name: ESXi Backdoor Account Add Followed by Syslog Disable
xql_queries.query:
dataset = esxi_syslog
| filter command contains "esxcli system account add" or command contains "syslog config set --loghost"
| comp count_distinct(command) as stages by agent_hostname, user
| filter stages >= 2
